title: Keratin Complex shows off its Fashion Therapy line and more!
description: Senior Associate Editor Alyson Kerr chats with Keratin Complex's Lindsay Solomon and Martino Cartier about the company's new products. Keratin Complex Fashion Therapy includes the Bling Brush and Sparkle + Shine Keratin Highlighting Powder in gold, copper or bronze. Also check out the 5-in-1 Titanium Curling System, It's a Blonde Thing(tm) from the Color Therapy(tm) Collection, and new Demi-Glaze with Triple Protein Protection(tm)! http://www.beautylaunchpad.com
author: Beauty Launchpad
